query:
Go to http://localhost:7770/catalogsearch/result/?q=Quenby . Does every Quenby tee listing offer size M? Answer yes or no.

Before answering, open every tee listing in the search results, including any on later pages, and check every option the question needs on each one. Listings of anything else in the results are not part of the question and need not be opened. Do not stop early because a listing looks unpromising from its search-result price. Base the answer only on listings you have opened, and say how many you opened.

Size M listed but disabled (cannot be chosen): 8 listings (igr-rp28-05 Pembroke, -22 Foxcombe, -41 Holbeck, -24 Yarrow, -34 Oakfield, -14 Thornbury, -10 Redhill, -18 Copperfield)

Since 18 of the 45 opened tee listings do not actually offer a purchasable size M (and 10 don't carry M at all), the answer is No.
